meta.title: 雅思听力场景高频词
meta.description: 覆盖 Section 1-4 高频场景：预订/旅行、图书馆、课程咨询、银行、健康、环保讲座、动植物、考古

words.sentence: The accommodation fee covers both rent and utilities.
words.sentence_cn: 住宿费包含房租和水电费。

words.sentence: You need to pay a deposit of 200 dollars, which is refundable.
words.sentence_cn: 你需要付200美元押金，是可以退还的。

words.sentence: Could you send me an invoice for the order?
words.sentence_cn: 能给我开一张这批货的发票吗？

words.sentence: Tickets are non-refundable unless the event is cancelled.
words.sentence_cn: 除非活动取消，否则门票不予退款。

words.sentence: Each participant will receive a gift voucher worth 50 pounds.
words.sentence_cn: 每位参与者将获得一张价值50英镑的礼品券。

words.sentence: The travel agent emailed me a detailed itinerary.
words.sentence_cn: 旅行社给我发了一份详细的行程单。

words.sentence: The hotel organises a boat excursion every Saturday.
words.sentence_cn: 酒店每周六组织��次乘船短途游。

words.sentence: The ferry to the island departs twice a day.
words.sentence_cn: 去岛上的渡轮每天发两班。

words.sentence: A free shuttle runs between the airport and the hotel.
words.sentence_cn: 机场和酒店之间有免费摆渡车。

words.sentence: The train to Oxford leaves from platform 3.
words.sentence_cn: 去牛津的火车从3号站台发车。

words.sentence: Left luggage facilities are available in the basement.
words.sentence_cn: 行李寄存处设在地下一层。

words.sentence: You must apply for a visa at least four weeks in advance.
words.sentence_cn: 你必须至少提前四周申请签证。

words.sentence: Enrolment for the autumn term closes on Friday.
words.sentence_cn: 秋季学期的注册周五截止。

words.sentence: All freshmen attend an orientation session on Monday.
words.sentence_cn: 所有新生周一参加迎新培训。

words.sentence: She leads a weekly seminar on research methods.
words.sentence_cn: 她每周主持一次研究方法研讨课。

words.sentence: Your dissertation proposal is due at the end of the month.
words.sentence_cn: 论文开题报告月底截止。

words.sentence: The university takes plagiarism very seriously.
words.sentence_cn: 大学对剽窃行为非常严肃处理。

words.sentence: Don't forget to attach a bibliography at the end.
words.sentence_cn: 别忘了在结尾附上参考书目。

words.sentence: Current periodicals are shelved on the second floor.
words.sentence_cn: 现刊陈列在二楼。

words.sentence: You can search the library catalogue online.
words.sentence_cn: 你可以在网上检索图书馆目录。

words.sentence: I'd like to make a reservation for two nights.
words.sentence_cn: 我想预订两晚。

words.sentence: Annual membership costs 45 pounds, including insurance.
words.sentence_cn: 年费45英镑，含保险。

words.sentence: Cancel the subscription before the trial ends.
words.sentence_cn: 在试用结束前取消订阅。

words.sentence: You can pay the course fee in three instalments.
words.sentence_cn: 学��可以分三期支付。

words.sentence: He retired early and now lives on a pension.
words.sentence_cn: 他提前退休，现在靠养老金生活。

words.sentence: They took out a mortgage to buy the flat.
words.sentence_cn: 他们贷款买了这套公寓。

words.sentence: The project ran over budget by ten per cent.
words.sentence_cn: 项目超预算百分之十。

words.sentence: Keep the receipt in case you want a refund.
words.sentence_cn: 保留收据以便退款。

words.sentence: Tuition fees have risen sharply in recent years.
words.sentence_cn: 近年来学费大幅上涨。

words.sentence: She won a scholarship to study in Canada.
words.sentence_cn: 她获得了去加拿大留学的奖学金。

words.sentence: The doctor wrote a prescription for antibiotics.
words.sentence_cn: 医生开了抗生素处方。

words.sentence: Common symptoms include fever and a sore throat.
words.sentence_cn: 常见症状包括发烧和喉咙痛。

words.sentence: The injury kept him off work for a fortnight.
words.sentence_cn: 这次伤让他两周无法工作。

words.sentence: Physiotherapy sessions are held twice a week.
words.sentence_cn: 理疗每周进行两次。

words.sentence: Vaccination is required before travelling to the region.
words.sentence_cn: 前往该地区前需接种疫苗。

words.sentence: The local surgery opens at eight in the morning.
words.sentence_cn: 当地诊所早上八点开门。

words.sentence: The polar bear's natural habitat is under threat.
words.sentence_cn: 北极熊的自然栖息地正受到威胁。

words.sentence: Coastal erosion is accelerating due to rising sea levels.
words.sentence_cn: 海平面上升正在加速海岸侵蚀。

words.sentence: Modern irrigation systems have doubled the yield.
words.sentence_cn: 现代灌溉系统使产量翻倍。

words.sentence: Overuse of chemical fertilisers damages the soil.
words.sentence_cn: 化肥过度使用会损害土壤。

words.sentence: The pesticide was banned after links to bee decline emerged.
words.sentence_cn: 这种杀虫剂因与蜜蜂数量下降有关而被禁用。

words.sentence: The region suffered its worst drought in a century.
words.sentence_cn: 该地区遭遇百年最严重干旱。

words.sentence: Heavy rain caused severe flooding in the valley.
words.sentence_cn: 大雨导致山谷严重洪涝。

words.sentence: The charity funds conservation projects worldwide.
words.sentence_cn: 该慈善机构资助全球保护项目。

words.sentence: Rainforests support the greatest biodiversity on earth.
words.sentence_cn: 雨林支撑着地球上最丰富的生物多样性。

words.sentence: The dodo became extinct in the seventeenth century.
words.sentence_cn: 渡渡鸟在十七世纪灭绝。

words.sentence: Several species of butterfly are native to the island.
words.sentence_cn: 几种蝴蝶是这座岛的原生物种。

words.sentence: The birds return here each year for the breeding season.
words.sentence_cn: 这些鸟每年回到这里繁殖。

words.sentence: The migration route covers thousands of miles.
words.sentence_cn: 迁徙路线绵延数千英里。

words.sentence: The excavation revealed remains of a Roman villa.
words.sentence_cn: 发掘出土了一座罗马别墅的遗迹。

words.sentence: Museum staff dated the artefact to the Bronze Age.
words.sentence_cn: 博物馆人员将这件文物断代到青铜时代。

words.sentence: Fragments of pottery were found at the site.
words.sentence_cn: 现场发现了陶器碎片。

words.sentence: The town grew rich on the textile trade.
words.sentence_cn: 这座城镇靠纺织业致富。

words.sentence: Farmers moved their livestock to higher ground.
words.sentence_cn: 农民把牲畜转移到高处。

words.sentence: This year's wheat harvest was disappointing.
words.sentence_cn: 今年小麦收成不佳。

words.sentence: Kitchen waste can be turned into compost.
words.sentence_cn: 厨余垃圾可以变成堆肥。

words.sentence: The centre is run entirely by volunteers.
words.sentence_cn: 该中心完全由志愿者运营。

words.sentence: Proceeds from the sale go to a local charity.
words.sentence_cn: 销售所得捐给当地慈善机构。

words.sentence: Check whether your insurance covers personal belongings.
words.sentence_cn: 确认你的保险是否涵盖个人财物。

words.sentence: The samples were analysed in a laboratory in Sydney.
words.sentence_cn: 样本在悉尼的一间实验室做了分析。

words.sentence: Most first-years live on campus.
words.sentence_cn: 大多数新生住在校内。

words.sentence: The landlord said the rent is due on the first of each month.
words.sentence_cn: 房东说每月一号交房租。

words.sentence: The previous tenant left the flat in good condition.
words.sentence_cn: 前租户离开时公寓状况良好。

words.sentence: The flat is fully furnished, including a fridge and a washing machine.
words.sentence_cn: 公寓带全套家具，含冰箱和洗衣机。

words.sentence: Utilities are not included in the monthly rent.
words.sentence_cn: 水电气费不含在月租内。

words.sentence: Report any faulty kitchen appliance to the agency.
words.sentence_cn: 厨房电器有故障请联系中介。

words.sentence: There is a plumbing problem in the bathroom—the tap keeps dripping.
words.sentence_cn: 浴室水管有问题，水龙头一直滴水。

words.sentence: The science block will be closed for renovation until March.
words.sentence_cn: 科学楼因翻新关闭至三月。

words.sentence: The property market in this area has cooled down recently.
words.sentence_cn: 该地区房产市场最近降温。

words.sentence: There are still two vacancies at the front desk.
words.sentence_cn: 前台还有两个空缺职位。

words.sentence: Each applicant must bring a passport photo.
words.sentence_cn: 每位申请人需带一张护照照片。

words.sentence: Send your resume and cover letter before Friday.
words.sentence_cn: 周五前把简历和求职信发过来。

words.sentence: She has a job interview at the bank tomorrow.
words.sentence_cn: 她明天在银行有个面试。

words.sentence: A teaching qualification is essential for this post.
words.sentence_cn: 教师资格证是这个岗位的必要条件。

words.sentence: My colleague will take over the project while I am away.
words.sentence_cn: 我不在时项目由同事接手。

words.sentence: The starting salary is 28,000 dollars a year.
words.sentence_cn: 起薪为年薪两万八千美元。

words.sentence: New staff are on probation for the first three months.
words.sentence_cn: 新员工头三个月为试用期。

words.sentence: Workers get double pay for overtime on Sundays.
words.sentence_cn: 周日加班员工拿双倍工资。

words.sentence: The hotel has a fitness centre and a swimming pool.
words.sentence_cn: 酒店设有健身中心和游泳池。

words.sentence: The athletics meeting was postponed due to rain.
words.sentence_cn: 田径运动会因雨延期。

words.sentence: The referee stopped the match in the second half.
words.sentence_cn: 裁判在下半场中止了比赛。

words.sentence: The new stadium can hold 60,000 spectators.
words.sentence_cn: 新体育场可容纳六万名观众。

words.sentence: She won the national championship three years in a row.
words.sentence_cn: 她连续三年夺得全国冠军。

words.sentence: There is a yoga class every Tuesday evening.
words.sentence_cn: 每周二晚有瑜伽课。

words.sentence: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.sentence_cn: 小镇每年夏天举办音乐节。

words.sentence: The celebration will begin with a street parade.
words.sentence_cn: 庆祝活动将以街头游行开场。

words.sentence: The fireworks display starts at nine by the river.
words.sentence_cn: 焰火表演九点在河边开始。

words.sentence: Thousands of visitors came for the annual carnival.
words.sentence_cn: 数千游客前来参加年度嘉年华。

words.sentence: An exhibition of local artists is on at the gallery.
words.sentence_cn: 画廊正在举办本地艺术家展览。

words.sentence: The venue for this year's fair has changed.
words.sentence_cn: 今年集市的举办地点变了。

words.sentence: A single fare to the city centre costs three pounds.
words.sentence_cn: 到市中心单程票价三英镑。

words.sentence: Take the shuttle bus to Terminal 2 for domestic flights.
words.sentence_cn: 乘摆渡车到二号航站楼搭国内航班。

words.sentence: Only pedestrians are allowed in the old town after ten.
words.sentence_cn: 十点后老城区只允许行人进入。

words.sentence: The path is shared by cyclists and joggers.
words.sentence_cn: 这条路由骑行者和慢跑者共用。

words.sentence: My daily commute takes about forty minutes.
words.sentence_cn: 我每天通勤约四十分钟。

words.sentence: Accidents often happen at this busy junction.
words.sentence_cn: 这个繁忙路口经常发生事故。

words.sentence: Check the timetable for the last train to Oxford.
words.sentence_cn: 查一下去牛津末班车的时刻表。

words.sentence: You need to open a bank account to receive your salary.
words.sentence_cn: 你需要开个银行账户来收工资。

words.sentence: You can exchange foreign currency at the airport.
words.sentence_cn: 机场可以兑换外币。

words.sentence: Payment by cheque is no longer accepted.
words.sentence_cn: 不再接受支票付款。

words.sentence: Postage to Europe starts at five pounds.
words.sentence_cn: 寄往欧洲的邮费五英镑起。

words.sentence: I would like to send this parcel by airmail.
words.sentence_cn: 我想航空邮寄这个包裹。

words.sentence: A bank transfer usually takes two working days.
words.sentence_cn: 银行转账通常需要两个工作日。

words.sentence: The restaurant offers a wide range of vegetarian dishes.
words.sentence_cn: 餐厅提供丰富的素食菜品。

words.sentence: The city is famous for its spicy local cuisine.
words.sentence_cn: 这座城市以辛辣的本地菜肴闻名。

words.sentence: Let us order a takeaway instead of cooking.
words.sentence_cn: 我们点外卖吧，不做饭了。

words.sentence: Hot beverages are served in the buffet car.
words.sentence_cn: 餐车供应热饮。

words.sentence: There is a snack machine on the second floor.
words.sentence_cn: 二楼有零食自动售货机。

words.sentence: These boots were a real bargain in the sale.
words.sentence_cn: 这靴子打折时买真划算。

words.sentence: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
words.sentence_cn: 笔记本电脑保修两年。

words.sentence: Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
words.sentence_cn: 保留收据作为购买凭证。

words.sentence: Goods can be returned for exchange within 14 days.
words.sentence_cn: 十四天内商品可退换。

words.sentence: She bought a model bridge as a souvenir.
words.sentence_cn: 她买了座桥的模型作纪念品。

words.sentence: Please collect your belongings before leaving the train.
words.sentence_cn: 下车前请拿好随身物品。

words.sentence: He reported the loss of his wallet to the police.
words.sentence_cn: 他向警方报失了钱包。

words.sentence: You'd better take an umbrella—it is going to rain.
words.sentence_cn: 最好带把伞，要下雨了。

words.sentence: Bring a torch for the evening walk in the bush.
words.sentence_cn: 晚间丛林散步请带手电筒。

words.sentence: Pick up a free brochure at the visitor centre.
words.sentence_cn: 在游客中心免费领取一本手册。

words.sentence: Please quote this reference number when you call.
words.sentence_cn: 来电时请报这个参考编号。

words.sentence: For further enquiries, call the 24-hour helpline.
words.sentence_cn: 更多咨询请拨打24小时服务热线。
